name: Rush To The Airport 🎫✈️
desc:
✈️ Welcome to **Rush to the Airport!**

🎫 Grab your ticket—your flight is waiting!
🏃 Race through the airport before time runs out!
🚧 Dodge obstacles and make your way to the gate!
🛂 Get through security and reach your plane in time!
🛫 Take off and explore exciting destinations around the world!
🌍 Play again to unlock new adventures and discover more places!

👀 Can you make it to your flight before it's too late?

llm.loop: grab a ticket -> race through the airport dodging obstacles -> pass security -> reach the gate and board -> take off to a destination -> replay to unlock more places
llm.objectives: make your flight in time and unlock new destinations
llm.instructions: race through the airport before time runs out, dodge obstacles, get through security and reach your plane
unique: airport-rush scenario with paid line/traffic skips and troll tools like detain and ban hammer
monetization_signals: troll items (ban hammer, gravity gun, kill all, scare all, detain, air horn)
llm.thumbnails: cartoon airport icon, avatar with suitcase running toward a departing plane, panicked avatar on a plane with Statue of Liberty outside
llm.complexity_notes: linear airport map with obstacles and scripted flight/destination sequences; genre listed as Idle, exact structure unclear
